opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing key questions in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.summary: Supports members to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or finalize projects, and to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; intended to fund events hosted by members or Society Representatives.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, such as internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Supports postdoctoral researchers with additional funding to help them achieve their full potential, covering consumables, equipment, and other justified costs.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles within physiological sciences.
